Allient Inc is a public company that trades under the ticker ALNT and is headquartered in Williamsville, New York. Its listed website is alantra.com, and the text on that site describes Alantra as an international financial services firm with over 500 professionals across EMEA, the Americas, and Asia. According to that text, the firm provides investment banking and alternative asset management services to corporations, family-owned companies, and institutional investors, and it describes its listed partnership model as giving teams autonomy within corporate governance structures while keeping them personally invested in the firm.

The record holds no products for the company and no MCP servers, so there is no AI product line to describe here. The only identifiers on file are the ticker ALNT and the SEC central index key 0000046129.

On litigation, the record lists no individual cases. It does carry a New York jurisdiction entry with a count of 458.
